INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.

5. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.

6. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.

7. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

9. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Graphic Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Audial- Visual Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
